subject: maths
question:
A shopkeeper offers the following four schemes:

A) Two successive discounts of 39% and 8%

B) Buy 8, get 4 free

C) A single discount of 16%

D) Two successive discounts of 38% and 34%

Which scheme is best for the shopkeeper?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Find effective discount for each scheme

A ⇒ 39 + 8 − (39×8/100) = 47 − 3.12 = 43.88%

B ⇒ Buy 8 get 4 ⇒ discount = 4/12 × 100 = 33.33%

C ⇒ 16%

D ⇒ 38 + 34 − (38×34/100) = 72 − 12.92 = 59.08%

**∴ Best for shopkeeper = C (least discount)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Four discount schemes A, B, C, D

**Formula used:**

Successive discount = a + b − (ab/100), Buy X get Y ⇒ Y/(X+Y) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ A: 39 + 8 − (39×8/100) = 43.88%

⇒ B: 4/(8+4) × 100 = 33.33%

⇒ C: 16%

⇒ D: 38 + 34 − (38×34/100) = 59.08%

⇒ Compare discounts: 16 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Successive Discount

Net = a + b − (ab/100)

Buy X Get Y

Discount = Y/(X+Y) × 100

Key Insight

Shopkeeper prefers minimum discount (maximum profit)
